flags.content: Keon Coleman, Bills: Buffalo turned away trade interest earlier this offseason, which is the strongest public signal that Coleman is still part of the team’s long-term receiving plan. For fantasy purposes, that preserves the possibility of an expanded role rather than a trade-driven reset. [52]
flags.note: Team still believes in Keon Coleman

flags.content: Jauan Jennings, Vikings: he is set to visit this week, which is the clearest sign today that Minnesota may still be searching for another receiver fit. The specifics of any role or contract are not specified. [4]

**Bo Nix, Broncos:** The second ankle procedure matters mainly for workload management, not availability, since he is still expected to be ready for the season. [3, 36] The key watch is whether Denver limits his offseason reps. [36]

sources.title: Nix had second procedure on ankle, sources say

For Broncos QB Bo Nix, having a follow-up cleanup procedure after a fractured ankle is not rare or unexpected and he’s still expected to be ready for the season. That said, don’t be surprised if the team takes it very easy with him this spring.
